name: docket-auth-edge-worker
description: AEM Edge Function (Fastly Compute) providing all-or-nothing site authentication.

scripts.deploy:red: sh scripts/aio-context.sh use red && npm run build && npm run deploy
scripts.deploy:writing: sh scripts/aio-context.sh use writing && npm run build && npm run deploy
scripts.tail:red: sh scripts/aio-context.sh use red && aio aem edge-functions tail-logs docket-auth
scripts.tail:writing: sh scripts/aio-context.sh use writing && aio aem edge-functions tail-logs docket-auth
